task.title: Implement kill switch fast-path through runtime-manager (EVO-005)
task.summary_zh: DEVELOPMENT_WORKBREAKDOWN EVO-005：Kill Switch 和 Safe Mode 的 emergency fast-path 必須繞過正常 governance review queue、但仍流過 runtime-manager；audit trail 保留；kill-switch latency 目標在 benchmark scenario 下驗證。
acceptance: Kill Switch 和 Safe Mode 透過 runtime-manager fast-path endpoint 可觸發，不需走 governance review queue
觸發後 audit log 仍記錄完整 trail
latency benchmark test 存在且 pass
task.next: Owner finalized: all 38 tests pass (kill-switch fast-path, safe-mode state machine, audit trail, latency benchmark ≤5ms, cross-instance durability, corrupt-snapshot recovery). Review approved by Codex after durability hardening (commit d0eb7ec). EVO-005 officially closed.
review_notes_zh: Reviewer recheck 通過：補上 kill_switch.json 原子覆寫與壞檔隔離，避免 durability sidecar 半寫入或損毀時把 runtime-manager 啟動卡死。|驗證通過：cross-instance safe-mode/audit durability、manual safe-mode advance persistence、corrupt snapshot recovery；services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py 現在 38 tests 全綠。

delivery.commit_subject: DEPTH-EVO005: owner closure checkpoint — kill-switch fast-path finalized

handoffs.message: Kill-switch fast-path implementation complete. Added 26 tests covering: (1) KillSwitchController unit tests — classify/dispatch, action selection, safe-mode state machine, audit trail; (2) service-layer dispatch, audit trail, safe-mode advance, invalid-reason rejection; (3) HTTP route tests for all three kill-switch endpoints (dispatch, safe-mode GET/POST, audit-log) with auth guard and field validation; (4) latency benchmark over 1000 iterations passes ≤5 ms/iter target. All 34 tests pass. Commit: 46ceec6. All EVO-005 acceptance criteria met.
Auto-reassigned review from Gemini to Codex after repeated Gemini capacity/429: Capacity / rate limit failure

Review found a blocker: kill-switch safe-mode and audit trail are process-local only, so restart/worker switch loses state. See services/execution/runtime-manager/review_evo005_codex_zh.md and restore durability before re-review.

Durability fix complete (commit d0eb7ec). Added dump_state/load_state to KillSwitchController; RuntimeManagerService now writes kill_switch.json before acking every dispatch and safe-mode advance; new service instances load from that file on init. Three cross-instance regression tests added and all 37 tests pass. Reproduction case from review now shows svc2 reads back correct safe-mode and audit count. Ready for re-review.
Reviewer recheck passed after durability hardening; kill-switch fast-path now persists safely across restarts and tolerates corrupt snapshots. Owner may finalize to done.
